scope: Independent read-only AC producer, monitor, preparation-path and fixed-cost review; actual prepared inputs and final protocol still require later review.

resources.child_RLIMIT: 7200 minus aggregate CPU already consumed, not the initial phase ceiling
resources.process_accounting: Recorded four-field pid/ppid/pgid/start_ticks schema, process-group CPU including descendants through mandatory teardown, subreaper, exact-parent binding and no resume.
resources.initial_projection: Monitor checks both 3390 screen and 3790 confirmation projections before allowing screen; startup uses monitored cumulative CPU.
resources.selected_projection: Both winners fixed first; all 12 role/world rates retained, including genotype duplicates; threshold3790.

work.selection: Whole production F mean over all32 seeds, mutant rows1..64 only, lowest row-index tie.

dependencies.AB: Operational clean terminal only; complete or incomplete/failure terminal accepted when queues empty and cleanup successful. No AB scientific outcome criterion.
dependencies.Y: Exact complete original panels, mutation provenance, original blink selections and all130 historical timing rows.

phase_binding: Startup identity, request/receipt hashes, row-index snapshots and frozen selection/projection/role/genotype artifacts rechecked at later boundaries and terminal completion.

checks.suite_execution: Owner execution receipt inspected; no duplicate test run by this reviewer.

limitations: Four tiny flash calibration batches do not bound all mutant costs; cumulative monitored caps are authoritative.
Fixed backgrounds and world-by-selection interactions do not establish independent evolutionary replicates or isolate memory.
This source-only review does not authorize registration, preparation, release or simulation.
